scripts.check:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run audit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @studio/shared test && pnpm --filter @studio/server test && pnpm --filter @studio/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @studio/server test:coverage && pnpm --filter @studio/web test:coverage
scripts.test:transitions: pnpm --filter @studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @studio/shared test transition && pnpm --filter @studio/server test:transitions && pnpm --filter @studio/web test:transitions
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @studio/shared build && cross-env RUN_VISUAL_REGRESSION=1 pnpm --filter @studio/server test:visual
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm --filter @studio/shared build && cross-env RUN_VISUAL_REGRESSION=1 UPDATE_VISUAL_SNAPSHOTS=1 pnpm --filter @studio/server test:visual:update
